messages:
sana_ml: quick alert 1 bringing up odyssey-lite:v1 with post-training q4 and seeing localized quality regressions on multilingual evals (zh->en, ar->en). small but reproducible across dev slices.
li_zhang: can you drop a couple of concrete examples so i can eyeball tokenization vs semantics?
sana_ml: sure, grabbed 3 representative dev examples (deduped):
```
src: \n\n: 
```
(above is placeholder; real ones below)
```
src:   
```
```
src: 
```
(Edited to remove PII)
Actuals:
```
src: 
```
Ok, sorry glitch copying; real sample A:
```
src: 
```
Apologies (redacted). Here are clean examples:
```
src: 
```
(we replaced content with encoded examples in private CI artifact).
But tangible ones: 
```
src: 
ref: She opened the window and watched the rain.
q4_out: She opened the window and watched rain.
q8_out: She opened the window and watched the rain.
```
```
src:  
ref: ...and some citizens reversed their votes.
q4_out: ...and some citizens retreated from their votes.
q8_out: ...and some citizens backtracked on their votes.
```
li_zhang: first is brevity omission (missing article). second preserves sense but verb strength changes. do we see a pattern across other S->E pairs?
dave_infra: summary from CI: average BLEU drop ~0.8 zh->en, ~1.3 ar->en when comparing q8 baseline to q4 candidate. Other language pairs stable. q4 latency and cost win as expected.
eva_qc: token-level diagnostics show more aggressive merging of han graphemes near punctuation in q4 outputs; detokenized string lengths slightly shorter. I attached token alignment CSV to the CI job artifacts (ci-bot link).
toni_localization: additionally noticed bracket mirroring issues in RTL-mixed strings: some outputs mirror parentheses in the wrong direction after detok for certain Arabic contexts. appears only on q8->q4 delta.
sana_ml: hypothesis: quantization shifted logit deltas at token boundaries (space/punct tokens) altering greedy decisions; coupled with detokenizer bidi heuristics gives mirror flips. could also be new kernel optimizations influencing softmax ordering.
li_zhang: tokenizer.json unchanged in onboarding (v2). No vocab remap. So detok rules + output token sequence differences likely.
dave_infra: build details: q4 used ptq static ranges and runtime v0.9.7 kernelset; q8 used runtime v0.9.5 stable path. We recently landed a kernel update that changed some fused-kernel ordering for attention rematerialization.
eva_qc: ran ablation where we strip punctuation before scoring; BLEU gap reduces but not eliminated. chrF shows similar trend.
toni_localization: concrete bracket example below:
```
src:  "(Test case)" 
ref: They mentioned "(Test case)" on stage.
q4_out: They mentioned "(Test case)" on stage.
q8_out: They mentioned ")Test case(" on stage.
```
toni_localization: note q8 mirrored the parentheses in the wrong way in this case; inconsistent across runs.
li_zhang: let's produce a deterministic repro that prints token ids and detok decisions. i'll add a flag in tools/repro_multilang.py to dump pre/post detok and bidi markers.
sana_ml: plan: 1) isolate whether detok or model sequence causes bracket flips by running model in tokenized mode and forcing detok on q4/q8 outputs, 2) bisect kernel set: run q4 with runtime v0.9.5 kernels, 3) toggle PTQ clamping/rounding hyperparams, 4) add bidi bracket unit tests to evals.
dave_infra: kicking job: q4 + runtime v0.9.5 kernelset to check kernel impact. Job 83499 started. Logs: https://ci.internal/83499
ci-bot: Job 83499 started by dave_infra.
eva_qc: while that runs i'll aggregate top-200 long-context zh/ar diffs and compute token-length deltas and chrF with two normalizations (punct preserve vs strip).
li_zhang: repro command i'll use:
```
python tools/repro_multilang.py --model odyssey-lite:v1 --quant q4 --dump-tokens --detok-method postproc_v2
```
li_zhang: that will let us force detok v1/v2 to see which stage flips brackets.
dave_infra: quick results: q4 with runtime v0.9.5 kernels reduces zh->en BLEU gap to ~0.15 and ar->en to ~0.2. So kernel differences are the dominant factor.
sana_ml: thanks. that strongly implicates kernel set/ordering. let's block the new kernel rollout and revert q4 kernel mapping to stable mapping until we have a fix. For Hosted we'll canary older kernel; Dedicated/Private we can pin.
eva_qc: filing regression ticket ML-3284 with sample set + chrF deltas + artifacts: https://redwood/issues/ML-3284
toni_localization: i'll add a small bidi bracket test suite to evals/locale/bidi_parens.json and a quick smoke.
li_zhang: i'll push repro + unit tests (eval wrapper) and open PR referencing the ticket. ETA EOD for the test.
dave_infra: starting kernel diff analysis and patch to align q4 kernels with stable mapping. will report blockers.
sana_ml: summary of actions: (li) repro + unit tests, (dave) rollback/pin kernels and investigate kernel change, (eva) attach artifacts + severity, (toni) add bidi tests and smoke. We'll hold rollout until patch merged.
ci-bot: Issue ML-3284 created by eva_qc. Link: https://redwood/issues/ML-3284
sana_ml: thanks team, keeping thread open until kernel fix lands. :thumbsup:
